Write a vilma.beta Object to Disk

Source: R/write.vilma.beta.R
write.vilma.beta.Rd

Exports a vilma.beta object to disk. The set of files written depends on the beta-diversity algorithm used and stored in vilma.beta$algorithm:

  • PhyloSor: writes similarity and dissimilarity CSV matrices, a set of rasters (one per entry in vilma.beta$rasters), and a text summary via print.vilma.beta().

  • PhyloBeta: writes total dissimilarity, turnover, and nestedness CSV tables, a set of rasters (one per entry in vilma.beta$rasters), and a text summary.

  • Other algorithms (e.g., UniFrac, Rao β): writes a single CSV named after the algorithm, a set of rasters (one per entry in vilma.beta$rasters), and a text summary.

Usage

write.vilma.beta(
  vilma.beta,
  file,
  raster.format = c("tif", "grd", "img"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

Arguments

vilma.beta

A vilma.beta object returned by one of the beta-diversity functions (e.g., phylo.beta, phylosor.calc, rao.beta, unifrac.calc).

file

Character string giving the prefix for output file names. The function appends appropriate extensions automatically.

raster.format

Character; output format for raster layers. One of "tif", "grd", or "img". Defaults to "tif" if multiple or invalid options are provided.

overwrite

Logical; whether to overwrite existing raster files. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

Invisibly returns NULL. Files are written to disk.

Details

The following files are created in the current working directory:

If vilma.beta$algorithm == "PhyloSor":

  • <file>_dissimilarity.csv — dissimilarity matrix.

  • <file>_similarity.csv — similarity matrix.

  • <file>_<raster_name>.<format> — one raster per entry in vilma.beta$rasters.

  • <file>_log.txt — textual summary from print.vilma.beta().

If vilma.beta$algorithm == "PhyloBeta":

  • <file>_dissimilarity.csv — total dissimilarity matrix.

  • <file>_turnover.csv — turnover component.

  • <file>_nestedness.csv — nestedness component.

  • <file>_<raster_name>.<format> — one raster per entry in vilma.beta$rasters.

  • <file>_log.txt — textual summary from print.vilma.beta().

Otherwise (e.g., UniFrac, Rao β):

  • <file>_<algorithm>.csv — dissimilarity matrix for the algorithm.

  • <file>_<raster_name>.<format> — one raster per entry in vilma.beta$rasters.

  • <file>_log.txt — textual summary from print.vilma.beta().

Absolute paths to the written files are printed to the console on completion.

See also

phylo.beta, phylosor.calc, rao.beta, unifrac.calc, print.vilma.beta, view.vilma.beta

Author

Omar Daniel Leon-Alvarado https://leon-alvarado.weebly.com/ J. Angel Soto-Centeno https://www.mormoops.com

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# PhyloSor output
write.vilma.beta(vilma_beta_phylosor, file = "results/phylosor")

# PhyloBeta output
write.vilma.beta(vilma_beta_phylobeta, file = "results/phylobeta")

# Other algorithm (e.g., UniFrac / Rao beta)
write.vilma.beta(vilma_beta_unifrac, file = "results/unifrac")
} # }
